items.question: What elements constitute the fifth and sixth ritual placements in this sequence?
premises: The fifth ritual placement is performed with the zodiac signs.
The sixth ritual placement is performed with the seats.
Both placements are declared as part of the prescribed sequence.
items.inference: The fifth and sixth ritual placements are respectively identified by the zodiac signs and the seats.
items.plain_english: The fifth placement is performed with the zodiac signs, and the sixth is declared to be performed with the seats.
